profile.headline: Software Engineer at Carvana
profile.summary: I have been tricking people into thinking I can program since 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Skills: React.js · C# · SQL · Git · JavaScript · Microsoft Azure · Splunk · Datadog

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
- Managed and developed a project that merged several static sites into one application
- Worked on bugs in several legacy Windows applications 
- In charge of updating multiple static webpages with new information and documentation
- Primary developer for implementing an FAQ page on the primary website
- Pulled customer data from an SQL database which was to be used for statistical analysis
- Assisted with the migration of customer data to a new database for an updated website

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: PoorDawg is a platform that gamifies the dog care experience for dog owners and lovers. It’s goal is to educate the user base on proper pet care practices and incentives through challenges and rewards. One of the key features of Poor Dawg is being able to gain points which are earned through completed challenges and can be redeemed for real life products. There is also a social aspect where members can interact with one another via a customized profile and can compete with other members within the Poor Dawg community through their accumulated points.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with WordPress and Wix platforms.
- Skills include: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Viewer Experience Advocate
positions.description:
- Assist viewers about account management, billing issues, content, and basic site and application navigation
- Provide account and application support to our viewers, specifically with regards to software functionality and troubleshooting of system configurations and network settings
- Give accurate and real-time responses to viewer inquiries

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description: Managed accounts for Quality Assurance customers within the pharmaceutical, medical device, and oil and gas industries. Worked closely with clients, suppliers, auditors, and inspectors on audit scheduling, event details, and scoping information. Consulted with clients on a weekly basis on strategies to reach their quality goals and deadlines.

positions.title: Branch Manager
positions.description: Ran a painting business from the bottom up from sales to production. Managed 10 workers in 5 separate painting crews and oversaw the production involving the homes of 25 clients.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description: Made beverages while maintaining a high level of customer service.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was involved in the assembly process of filling backpacks with goods such as food and toiletries for the homeless. I would then go out into the to distribute these backpacks to the homeless population in Los Angeles and Long Beach.

projects.title: Anglo-Saxon 7th Century plough coulter found in Kent
projects.description: Worked to unearth the remains of an Anglo Saxon Village. Used several forms of excavation to find artifacts including a plough coulter. Performed different forms of sorting and analysis on discovered artifacts.
